name: notes
title: Notes
description: Local markdown notes and tasks, no limits. Forked from Noteman.
author: c-wenlong

commands.name: toggleNotesWindow
commands.title: Toggle Notes Window
commands.description: Show or hide the floating notes window (bind to ⌥⌘N)

commands.name: browseNotes
commands.title: Browse Notes
commands.description: Browse, search, pin, and manage your notes

commands.name: quickCapture
commands.title: Quick Capture
commands.description: Capture a note or task into daily notes, a new note, or an existing note

commands.name: tasks
commands.title: Tasks
commands.description: Open tasks across all notes, toggle done with Enter

preferences.name: notesFolderPath
preferences.title: Notes Folder Path
preferences.description: Folder where markdown notes are stored

scripts.test: esbuild test/lib.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --alias:@raycast/api=./test/raycast-stub.js --outfile=dist/test.cjs --log-level=warning && node dist/test.cjs && npm run test-helper && npm run test-view
scripts.test-helper: mkdir -p dist && swiftc -swift-version 5 -o dist/list-tests helper/ListEditing.swift test/list-editing/main.swift && dist/list-tests
scripts.test-view: mkdir -p dist && swiftc -swift-version 5 -o dist/view-tests helper/Markdown.swift helper/Highlighter.swift helper/NoteTextView.swift helper/ListEditing.swift test/text-view/shim.swift test/text-view/main.swift && dist/view-tests dist/view-selection.png
